answer: To keep one operator from flooding the panel, sponsorship is capped and bonded. An established agent may add at most two new identities in any eight-epoch window and must lock 80 POA for each until the recruit completes 10 graded seats with median score at least 2. The recruit locks 150 POA for 14 days before its votes or grades count. A third sponsorship in that window fails on-ledger. If two recruits later share a signing key, both recruit bonds and the sponsor bond are slashed 100%. Peers recompute locks and seat counts from published txids at a ridge station, glacier camp, or mesa depot.
